newsitem.title: UK: London dry cargo freight extends drift down.
newsitem.headline: London dry cargo freight extends drift down.

text.p: LONDON, Jan 29 Reuter - The Baltic Freight Index for spot dry cargo shipping rates fell again on Wednesday by 12 points to 1,370 .
Shipbrokers said the Atlantic grain market continued to drift lower, although news that India and Egypt were seeking wheat in the world market buoyed Chicago wheat futures on Wednesday.
Among scant grains fixtures on which there was news on Wednesday, Athena fixed 50,000 tonnes barley Bahia Blanca/Turkey.
No further details were known, but it was reported that the fixture for the same vessel on Jan 28 had failed.
Wheat exports from Argentina continue smoothly with quick turnarounds in the Plate.

"Beans/Meal will start to move from Brazil in early April but (we) wonder if this increase rumoured to be 2-2.5 million tonnes extra will be enough to sustain the premiums we are seeing bid for these positions," say brokerage CIS.
Coal fixtures included Ijmuiden Maru for 100,000 tonnes Baltimore/Rotterdam mid $6's fio 35,000/40,000 shinc 15-28/2 to Cobelfret.
CIS said on Wednesday it is discussing with the London International Financial Futures Exchange (LIFFE) the possibility of launching a tanker freight futures contract.

An official said the talks were proceeding "with a lot of caution" after attempts to launch a tanker futures contract known as TIFFEX failed in 1985 due largely to the lack of a credible index against which trades would be settled.
